people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

translations.web: “But afterward I will reverse the captivity of the children of Ammon,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Yet afterward I will restore the Ammonites from captivity,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: But afterward I will bring back the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith Jehovah.
